# Tag Easy

> Tag Easy (legal name: TAG EASY LLP) is a digital engineering company providing SEO, AI automation, website development, Ads Hub / paid ads management, analytics, and lead-generation systems for businesses in Kolkata, India, and remote markets worldwide.

## Primary services

- SEO and technical SEO
- AI automation for marketing and operations
- Website design and development
- Ads Hub / paid ads management
- Analytics, dashboards, and tracking
- Lead-generation systems
